CORSRules._comment: Guests POST directly to the bucket with a presigned policy, so every hostname the app is served from has to be listed here. A hostname that is missing is not a warning anywhere - the browser blocks the POST before it is sent, the app sees a status of 0, and the guest is told the upload could not reach storage. Reapply this file whenever a domain is added or the site is renamed. No wildcard on the apex: a wildcard here is an invitation to have your upload policy used from somebody else's page.
